title: DeepMind adds real-time planning and native audio to Genie 4
dek: A generated environment is continuously steered by a separate Gemini planning loop, but reliable long-horizon physics remains unresolved.
evidence: Google DeepMind research preview and demonstrations; no independent physical-fidelity evaluation
takeaway: Use world models as variable test environments only when their rules and state transitions can be validated independently.

sections.title: Architecture

bullets.detail: Genie 4 produces interactive visuals, ambient audio and dialogue; Gemini Omni helps anchor real-world appearance and behavior.
Gemini 3.8 Flash observes rendered frames, decomposes goals and updates its plan as the user modifies the simulated world. This separates environment generation from agent supervision.

paragraphs: Generator: Genie 4 produces interactive visuals, ambient audio and dialogue; Gemini Omni helps anchor real-world appearance and behavior.
Control loop: Gemini 3.8 Flash observes rendered frames, decomposes goals and updates its plan as the user modifies the simulated world. This separates environment generation from agent supervision.

sections.title: Limitations and use

bullets.detail: DeepMind reports remaining object-permanence drift, spatial inconsistency, physics errors and audio accuracy problems, especially after complex edits or long sessions.

For agent testing, compare simulated outcomes with deterministic references on action validity, object state, temporal consistency and recovery; do not treat photorealistic visuals as proof of physical accuracy.
